title: The billing zone matches any path containing plan
desc:
profile.CRITICAL_ZONES['billing'] is billing|payment|invoice|subscription|checkout|stripe|paddle|quota|plan, matched anywhere in a path. skills/plan-change/SKILL.md, planner.py or explanation.md read as billing and are held to the critical bar; wb finish sent WB-58 to the standard route for it.

ACCEPTANCE:
- plan matches a pricing plan (plans/, plan_limits, subscription_plan) and not plan-change, planner or explanation
- a test pins both sides; plans already audited with the old zones re-audit cleanly or say why
